name: E36 S54 Oil Filter Housing Adapter for Oil Coolers (10AN)
description:
The ports on this adapter are M22x1.5

A Metric M22x1.5 to 10AN Banjo Bolt perfect for Oil Coolers or other tight-fitting areas. Our banjo bolts are pre-drilled for safety wire to prevent accidental rotation. Includes the banjo fitting, banjo bolt, and washer pair.

This Adapter is available in the following color: Black
